en: The front of the postcard displays a serene natural landscape with water, forested islands, and rolling hills. There are some distant buildings visible. The lower corner of the image contains the printed text 'AUGUST ABRAHAMSONS STIFTELSE.' and 'Hälsning från Nääs' (translating to 'Greetings from Nääs' in Swedish). There is additional handwritten Swedish text along the lower border. The reverse side includes a green stamp from Sweden with a postmark dated 1901, and fields labeled for address, residence, and name, with 'BREFKORT' (postcard) printed at the top.
